legos.why: PATTERN C. The taught side itself skips words of the seed, so the LEGO is not a piece of its seed (L32; L26 'a LEGO may contain only words its own seed says'). Re-cut to contiguous pieces of the seed. POV pass: Marathi 'than' is an ending on the word before it (-पेक्षा), so 'happier than' can only be written with a hole. Shortest cut: 'happier | जास्त आनंदी'. 'than' was taught at seed 117 (S0117L02) and 'to get away' is S0485L01, so 'happier than to get away' is built from taught pieces and needs no LEGO of its own (L30) — the basket already drills it.
